notes.title: Alternate Fire Overhaul
notes.content: the newest version is out! version 31 has plenty of bug fixes, but most exciting is the new system we have for handling primary and alternate fire. The new system allows us to have much more versatility than just zoom and iron sights. we now have alternate fire on several guns! the Assault Rifle has a rapid fire mode, the Smith Shotgun has a Slamfire burst, the Striker45 has a "Master-key" under-barrel shotgun, and the M16A1-GL has an under-barrel grenade launcher. there have been a couple other tweaks to other guns as well, and you can expect to see more alternate fire modes in the future.

notes.title: SUPER BLOOD WARRIORS DEV STREAM
notes.content: We are going to be streaming us playing the game, and it will be in a public server where you can join us through the demo. Hop on and shoot us in the head with your favorite weapons!
